name: NumberInput
description:
The NumberInput component is used to manage numeric input fields. It includes increment and decrement buttons, supports the scrubber interaction pattern for pointer-based value adjustment, and can be easily integrated with form libraries.

Rendered on its own, NumberInput displays the input with increment and decrement triggers using the Cerberus icons; pass `scrubber` to add the scrubber. It supports different sizes to match the design requirements of your application. To use it within a form, wrap it with the Field component.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An entry abstraction that renders the input with increment and decrement triggers and an optional scrubber

props.name: scrubber
props.description: Whether to show a scrubber for fine-tuning the value with the pointer. A direct `NumberInput.Scrubber` child also shows it.

parts.description: The root container of the NumberInput component.

props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for size.

props.name: locale
props.description: The current locale. Based on the BCP 47 definition.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the number input. Useful for composition.

props.name: name
props.description: The name attribute of the number input. Useful for form submission.

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the input element.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the number input is disabled.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the number input is readonly

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the number input value is invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the number input is required

props.name: pattern
props.description: The pattern used to check the <input> element's value against

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the input

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of the input when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the value of the input.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value of the number input

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value of the number input

props.name: step
props.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by when the `Shift` key is held.

props.name: smallStep
props.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by when the `Alt` key is held.

props.name: allowMouseWheel
props.description: Whether to allow mouse wheel to change the value

props.name: allowOverflow
props.description: Whether to allow the value overflow the min/max range

props.name: clampValueOnBlur
props.description: Whether to clamp the value when the input loses focus (blur)

props.name: focusInputOnChange
props.description: Whether to focus input when the value changes

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: The options to pass to the `Intl.NumberFormat` constructor

props.name: inputMode
props.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user. It also determines the type of keyboard shown to the user on mobile devices

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Function invoked when the value changes

props.name: onValueInvalid
props.description: Function invoked when the value overflows or underflows the min/max range

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Function invoked when the number input is focused

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Function invoked when the value is committed (when the input is blurred or the Enter key is pressed)

props.name: spinOnPress
props.description: Whether to spin the value when the increment/decrement button is pressed

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
